purpose: Configuration skeleton for national, coverage-measurable summer undergraduate research discovery. Populate target records from authoritative public directories before large crawls.

scope_estimates.scope: U.S. NSF REUs and related NSF undergraduate research programs
Other U.S. university SURP, SURF, SURE, SROP, and similar named programs
Medical schools, hospitals, cancer centers, and independent research institutes
Federal labs, agencies, and national research programs
Social science, humanities, field stations, museums, observatories, and specialized programs
International programs genuinely open to U.S. students

program_identity_policy.one_program_rule: A program identity is a separately named research program or application at a host institution.
count_as_one: A university-wide SURP with many participating labs
A network host page for one named host-specific application
A multi-year program with separate annual cycles
count_separately: Separate named neuroscience, chemistry, physics, cancer, or other departmental programs at the same institution
Separate host-specific applications in a national or international network when each host has its own program page or application process
never_count_as_program_identities: Program directories, news pages, advice pages, conference pages, alumni pages, or symposium pages

institutional_universes.crawl_strategy: Search every official domain with standardized institutional vocabulary.
Search every official domain with standardized institutional vocabulary.
Search every official domain, prioritizing known undergraduate research offices and STEM departments.
Use as completeness/backfill universe; prioritize four-year institutions, MSIs, research-active colleges, and institutions with research indicators.

institutional_universes.source: LCME and AACOM accredited school lists
institutional_universes.crawl_strategy: Search undergraduate research, summer biomedical research, graduate biomedical sciences, MD-PhD, diversity/pathway, and medical-school training pages.
Search education, training, cancer research, and undergraduate summer program pages.
Search clinical/translational science education and undergraduate research pathways at hubs and partner institutions.

institutional_universes.source: AIRI and curated independent research institute lists
institutional_universes.crawl_strategy: Search institute education, internships, summer scholars, undergraduate research, and training pages.

institutional_universes.source: NSF master list of Federally Funded Research and Development Centers
institutional_universes.crawl_strategy: Search each center for undergraduate internships and summer research programs.

institutional_universes.source: Organization of Biological Field Stations and FieldStations.org
institutional_universes.crawl_strategy: Search undergraduate research, REU, summer internship, field research, and summer scholars pages.
Search marine, ocean, coastal, aquatic, and summer undergraduate research pages.

institutional_universes.source: Official international research-program networks and host pages
institutional_universes.crawl_strategy: Search only programs genuinely open to U.S. undergraduate students or broadly international undergraduates; verify eligibility on official program pages.
